scope: 26-channel source-only original-ULog publication replay pilot. Preserve crops/split/window identity. Batch training-input builder and stateful runtime adapter validated on fixed source-only pilot. No production cache rebuild, UAV model training or deployment activation.
selection: At grid time t use the latest observation whose availability timestamp is <= t, with observation timestamp <= availability timestamp. Stable arrival order resolves duplicate availability timestamps. No interpolation, backward fill, future look-ahead, timestamp sorting, or fallback past an invalid latest observation.

availability.ULog_publication_time: May be used only as a declared replay proxy, not certified physical receive time
availability.runtime_receive_time: Required for live admission; aligned monotonic timebase and per-topic provenance must be demonstrated

approved_clock_mapping.clock: PX4 boot microseconds; no estimated shifting or future lookahead

freshness.budget_recipe: ceil_to_20ms(max_over_12_source_train_case_median_positive_publication_interval + max_over_case_median_publication_minus_observation_lag + 20ms). A declared engineering one-update-plus-grid-and-lag budget, not validated physical fault tolerance. Frozen before validation.
freshness.rule: Invalid timestamps fail, no silently substituting publication time for invalid sample time. Do not widen limits for validation coverage, fault cases or model scores. Prior 0.1/0.2/1s gap diagnostic cuts are not cleaning rules.

invalid_inputs: Retain row/time/index and invalid mask, represent missing values as NaN in intermediate data. Never zero-fill or forward-hold beyond explicit age bound. Require every frame/channel of a model window to be input-valid before inference; invalid-input is unavailable, not normal or fault. Do not bridge event intervals across unavailable time.
derived_features: acc_norm derives from selected same-frame acceleration components; relative barometric altitude subtracts the window first value before float32 conversion; normalization uses source-training-only statistics fitted for the eventual causal input version, never final tests. All paths must use the same transform and ordering.
label_masks: Input validity and endpoint label eligibility are separate. Training filters indices before model forward/BatchNorm and recomputes sampler/class weights on eligible source train labels. Evaluation selects frozen split/Real role explicitly and reports original denominators, unknown labels and unavailable inputs separately. -1 is not a third class. Continuous replay retains the complete time axis.
current_assets: Label-time v1 repairs retain legacy future-dependent X. They are retrospective evidence only, not causal model-training/deployment clearance. Historical 3680 RflySim normal suffix windows require their own timing provenance; do not automatically append into a causal version.

normalization_for_pilot.fit: 760 eligible original-cap64 windows from 12 source train anchors only, 114000 overlapping frame contributions
normalization_for_pilot.purpose: parity diagnostic only; never production coefficients

runtime_integration: CausalInputStream is an opt-in explicit observation/availability-clock adapter. Current TelemetryState snapshots lack per-topic arrival provenance; do not auto-convert snapshot time to each source clock. Old runtime and deployment unchanged.
